frozenComponents.onsetDetector: audio-to-midi-development-baseline-v1 detect_onsets unchanged for first P5 comparison

candidates.purpose: Allow independent kick/snare/hihat activations at one detected transient using interpretable class evidence instead of exclusive if/else classification.
constraints: one transient may emit zero, one, or multiple supported roles
no post-hoc use of the 12 consumed evaluation families
thresholds/scores must be frozen before real-easy or development comparison
unsupported clap/rim must not be relabeled solely to increase supported-class score

implementationFreeze.onsetEnvelope: per-class spectral-flux envelope computed from the class band of the same STFT
implementationFreeze.peakPicker: librosa.onset.onset_detect with the same pre_max=1, post_max=1, pre_avg=3, post_avg=3, delta and waitFrames as the frozen baseline
implementationFreeze.eventPolicy: each class is detected independently; multiple roles may be emitted at the same or neighboring transient
implementationFreeze.deduplication: same-role detections only; no cross-role suppression
implementationFreeze.velocity: same velocity_map contract as baseline, applied within each class envelope

candidates.purpose: Independent instrument activation comparison using partially fixed NMF/templates.
constraints: controlled-fixture templates may prove mechanics but cannot alone justify real-beat promotion
template provenance and rights must be explicit before real material is used
same event-level metrics and budget as candidate 1

externalReferenceOnly.reason: Demonstrates learned drum transcription with E-GMD, but historical Magenta implementation is archived and uses a legacy TensorFlow stack; integration/checkpoint licensing/runtime burden must be audited separately before any use.

curriculum.name: isolated_supported_hits
curriculum.advanceWhen: all supported isolated fixtures have transient recall 1.0 and class F1 1.0 at 30 ms; no regression versus baseline pass fixtures

curriculum.name: simultaneous_supported_hits
curriculum.advanceWhen: unique-transient recall remains 1.0 and every supported reference role at each simultaneous transient is recovered at 30 ms without extra supported-class false positives

curriculum.name: simple_rhythmic_patterns
curriculum.advanceWhen: both retain class F1 1.0 at 30 ms

curriculum.name: unsupported_role_diagnostic
curriculum.advanceWhen: diagnostic only; never used as a supported-class PASS requirement

curriculum.name: real_easy_authorized_beats
curriculum.advanceWhen: three real-easy identities/references are frozen before first candidate run; paired baseline/candidate metrics reported without using consumed evaluation families

curriculum.name: existing_development_regression
curriculum.advanceWhen: paired comparison on the existing 8 development families with event-level references available for the question being tested; human usefulness remains separate from event metrics

curriculum.name: representative_complexity
curriculum.advanceWhen: only after earlier levels pass; no fresh P6 cohort is consumed

selectionRule.controlledStage: candidate must satisfy levels 1-3 before real-easy comparison
selectionRule.realEasyAndDevelopment: select only if improvement addresses measured P3 failure without regression on baseline PASS cases and without unacceptable false activations
